children: Anusha Danamaraju takes on the HR Director role at Nationwide after leadership roles across HR business partnering, talent and organisational development

Anusha Danamaraju has been appointed Human Resources Director at Nationwide in Hyderabad. In her new role, she will contribute to the company’s people strategy in India, drawing on experience across HR business partnering, organisational development, talent acquisition, learning, talent management and culture.

Danamaraju joins Nationwide after more than four years at Providence India, where she served as Senior Manager – HRBP, Technology and Engineering. She worked with technology and engineering teams, with responsibilities spanning human capital and stakeholder management.

Before Providence India, she spent nearly three years at udaan.com as Senior Manager – HRBP. She was responsible for HR business partnering for the lifestyle vertical and business operations, while also working across learning, talent and culture initiatives.
Her responsibilities at udaan.com included managing employee groups and supporting leadership development and culture-building initiatives.
Danamaraju spent more than four years at Infosys across talent acquisition and organisational development roles.

As Lead – Organisation Development, she worked on career architecture, including defining roles, job descriptions, key result areas and competencies in partnership with business stakeholders. She also worked on talent mobility and reskilling initiatives covering a workforce of more than 2 lakh employees.

Earlier, as Lead – Talent Acquisition, she led business-school recruitment and helped hire more than 800 business-school graduates and chartered accountants. Her work also included campus engagement, offer-to-joining initiatives and recruitment for engineering schools.

Across her career, Danamaraju has worked across several areas of human resources, including HR business partnering, talent acquisition, career architecture, talent mobility, learning and development, organisational development and employee engagement.
Her experience includes supporting technology and business teams, designing talent processes, and working with stakeholders on workforce and capability requirements.
At Nationwide, Danamaraju will take on the HR Director position in Hyderabad, adding to the company’s senior HR leadership in India.
Her appointment brings experience across both specialist and business-facing HR functions, including talent acquisition, organisational development and HR business partnering, to her new role.
